# dsh-context attribution

This native Context Insights port is based on the functionality and information
layout of dsh-context 0.66.0 by bowenliang123:
https://github.com/bowenliang123/dsh-context

Reference revision: `f60e1a56439badf95927b9a811904d4d5b0b57b8`.

The upstream project is licensed under Apache License 2.0. A copy of its license
is included alongside this notice. PI-Desktop adapts the implementation to its
own runtime, persistence, IPC contracts, UI primitives and theme; upstream DSH
services and package dependencies are not included.
